text:
ashley: Quick sync — we need to lock priorities for Optimize toolkit next sprint. Customers pushed two urgent asks (eval-triggered alerts + mobile-friendly batching hints). Proposing: (1) M1: eval-triggered alert plumbing + basic rule UI, (2) M2: recommendations (batch/caching) doc + pilot hooks, (3) M3: quantization fallback optional. Thoughts?

sam: +1 on ordering. Clarify SLO we run to for alerts — is it quality regressions only or also latency/cost anomalies?

lee: From infra/ML side I recommend starting with quality/regression alerts tied to delta on eval metrics (per-prompt confidence + cohort drift). Latency/cost anomaly detection is separate signal and can be added later.

lee: example alert rule (sketch):
```
if eval_loss_delta > 0.08 OR concordance_drop_pct > 5% over 24h -> alert
attach sample prompts + last 50 outputs for triage
```

gina: Customer notes: AcmeHealth needs eval-triggered alerts integrated into their PagerDuty flow ASAP. Zephyr (mobile app) asked for lightweight batching hints (when to batch client requests on low-connectivity). Both want defaults + easy overrides.

sam: Implementation estimate: core alert plumbing + UI + PD integration = 2 sprints (1 infra + 1 UI/ops), batching hints MVP (rules + docs) = 1 sprint. Quantization recommendations (per-workload profiles) = 2 sprints after MVP.

kai: For rollout we need: KV cache metrics instrumentation, per-tenant eval buckets, and RBAC for who can mute alerts. Also recommend a canary: enable alerts for internal pilot customers first (redwood-internal + 2 beta customers).

ashley: Proposed launch criteria (must-haves):
- Eval alert firing on internal test suite with 0 false positives in 48h
- PD + email + Console notification delivery verified
- Cost delta signal is recorded (even if not alerted)
- Batching hints doc + example client snippet present
- Owner assigned for customer oncall for first 2 weeks

ashley: Acceptance checklist (short):
```
[ ] infra: alert pipeline + storage (kai)
[ ] ml: eval rule templates (lee)
[ ] ui: alert config UX + samples (sam)
[ ] cs: beta customer setup + runbook (gina)
```

gina: I'll prepare beta onboarding checklist and ask AcmeHealth for PD webhook + Zephyr for mobile telemetry sample by EOW.

sam: Will prototype alert UI flows this week. I can own the UI work. Need a quick API from infra to query eval diffs.

lee: I'll draft rule templates and provide example eval packs. Planning to freeze templates Monday.

kai: I'll add KV + eval metric dashboards and a canary enable flag. ETA: end of sprint if no blockers.

ashley: Owners: sam (UI + orchestration), lee (rules + templates), kai (infra + canary), gina (customer ops). I'll own milestone tracking and launch comms.

ashley: Next steps: sync tomorrow 10am PT to finalize scope and flag cut where needed. If anyone sees scope creep (quant fallback or advanced cost alerts) call it out now; prefer to ship narrow. :wave:

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Optimize toolkit - scope finalization" in #cal with attendees ashley, sam, lee, kai, gina — 2025-03-18 10:00 PT

gina: noted, will invite customer reps for a short slot in the meeting. :+1:

sam: sounds good. I'll bring a mockup.

lee: will bring rule examples and eval sample set.

kai: will confirm dashboards and canary toggles before the meeting.

ashley: Thanks team. Goal: ship alert plumbing + batching hints MVP to beta customers within next 6 weeks.
